out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed several spray bottles of cleaning products being stored next to sacks of flour. Observed two cans of WD-40 being stored on a food prep shelf.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED THE CLEANING PRODUCTS AND LUBRICANTS TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA. CONSOLIDATE ALL CHEMICAL PRODUCTS IN ONE AREAS SO THAT FOOD AND SINGLE SERVICE CONTAINERS DO NOT GET CONTAMINATED.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed a unlabeled spray bottle of bleach
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC LABELED THE BOTTLE AS BLEACH. LABEL ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) glass dessert display case was observed at 51f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. REPAIR COOLER. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET BETWEEN 32f-38f.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed exposed studs behind a 2DR stacked upright. Observed a large hole in the ceiling in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPAIR HOLE IN THE CEILING AND REPAIR WALL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the walk-in cooler, a large pot of pizza sauce was observed at 48f. Upon discussion with PIC, pizza sauce was prepared the night prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE PIZZA SAUCE.

violations.observation: Observed a can of WD-40 being stored on a shelf next to kitchen equipment.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE LUBRICANT TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at the handwashing sink was observed at 70f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER AT THE HANDSINK NEEDS TO BE AT LEAST 100f. PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: the cream cheese/mascarpone frosting on the carrot cake, red velvet cake, and cheesecakes were observed between 51f-54f in the dessert display cooler. Upon discussion, the cakes have been in the cooler since the night prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE CAKES.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the glass dessert display cooler was observed at 51f-54f. The digital display on the cooler was observed at 44f-45f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE HAVE THIS COOLER SERVICED. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 3DR prep top cooler for pizza was observed with a broken door gasket. Standing water was observed in the interior of the cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. COOLERS NEED TO BE IN GOOD REPAIR TO MAINTAIN APPROPRIATE COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES OF 41f OR LOWER. PLEASE HAVE THIS COOLER REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: The ceiling tiles above the cook line, specifically at the pizza station, were observed warped and heavily stained.
violations.corrective_action: Wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. CEILING TILES NEED TO BE SMOOTH, DURABLE, AND EASILY CLEANABLE. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION. DELI ITALIANO (Inspection Date: 05/27/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: EH observed no thermometer in 2 door preptop fridge on cookline during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC replaced thermometer in the 2 door prep top on cookline

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: EH observed bottles of oil and water being stored without common name labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC made labels for bottles

violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed no test kit for quaternary ammonia during the beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: PIC located Quat test strips during inspection, placed them near quaternary ammonia dispenser
